name: Grade 8 IIT Practice: August Week 12 - Demonstration
description: Practice words for Grade 8 second-trimester Arduino work.

words.definition: Showing the circuit, sensor trigger, code evidence, and test result.
words.example: The demonstration showed how the sensor triggered the alert.

words.definition: A simple drawing that shows parts or ideas.
words.example: The diagram labelled the sensor, LED, resistor, and buzzer.

words.definition: Code or screenshots that show how something was made.
words.example: Code evidence showed the condition that started the alert.
The test result proved the project worked at the chosen distance.

words.definition: An explanation of the circuit bug, test evidence, and final improvement.
words.example: The reflection explained which bug was hardest to fix.

words.definition: A working test version of the circuit used in the final demo.
words.example: The prototype reacted when an object moved close to the sensor.
